name: application-duration-input
title: Duration Input
description: Segmented hour and minute entry fields for elapsed time, timers, and estimates, with a quick-preset chip variant for common durations.
useWhen: Segmented hour and minute entry fields for elapsed time, timers, and estimates, with a quick-preset chip variant for common durations.
avoidWhen: Avoid duration input when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Duration Input uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
